cost_scope.note: Dry-run the 12 qualification reads before execution. An optional broad selected-column projection may be dry-run only; its estimate is separate from actual sample bytes and excludes embedding/index/lexical costs.

date_policy.sample_DATE_record_or_partition_mismatch: Retain and label diagnostically; require an explicit resolution before final dated corpus admission.
date_policy.sample_unknown_DATE_zero: Retain and label diagnostically; not automatically admissible to a dated corpus.

nested_selection_contract.checkpoint_policy: 100k, 1M and 2M are prefixes of one frozen ordering. Actual unique membership and adequate supply must be established before any claim of achieved counts.
nested_selection_contract.date_assignment: earliest admissible source observation within the frozen extraction scope; deterministic revision tie-break, with all provenance retained
nested_selection_contract.global_order: For date quota q and local selected document ordinal i starting at 1, sort by exact rational priority (2*i-1)/(2*q), then the seeded stratum order, then document identity.
nested_selection_contract.shortfall_policy: Report shortfalls and retain the frozen plan; do not silently expand source bounds, substitute arbitrary documents, or treat model failures as completed members.
nested_selection_contract.unit: normalized document identity after replay/revision/document deduplication and market eligibility
nested_selection_contract.within_date_order: SHA256 over a canonical JSON tuple of frozen seed and normalized document identity; tie-break by the complete document identity

qualification_scope: At most 12 single-day diagnostic samples, up to 200 raw qualifying observations each. These samples are not the final 2M manifest and are not a claim of final corpus coverage.
sampling_design: Equal weight per complete eligible calendar month; partial or coverage-incomplete months weighted by eligible-day fraction. Daily quotas divide each month equally. All supplied eligible dates remain planned source scope. This time-balanced history is not proportional to live news arrival volume.
